title: Figure 30: Characteristics Profiles of Object Sightings, Known vs. Unknown Evaluations
description: Six stacked line-graph panels (Total, Knowns, Astro, Aircraft, Balloon, Other), each plotted in "Per Cent" across shared characteristic categories grouped as Number of objects, Color, Speed, Shape and Duration. In each panel, a dashed line labeled "Unknown" is superimposed on the solid profile so the two can be compared. Caption: "FIGURE 30 CHARACTERISTICS PROFILES OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY TOTAL SAMPLE, KNOWN EVALUATIONS, AND INDIVIDUAL KNOWN EVALUATIONS, WITH UNKNOWN EVALUATIONS SUPERIMPOSED"; drawing B-7508, page 46.
